notes.title: The Backrooms Simulator v1.1 Release
notes.notes:
The update is finally here! The Backrooms Simulator now includes revolutionary features such as:


 Jumping for joy
 Flickering lights
 Tons of settings
 VR enhancements
 Improved lighting
 Unlockable achievements

notes.title: VR Update Coming Soon
notes.notes:
We're working hard on adding full VR support to the game and we'll be including it as a FREE update to anyone who owns the game! 

Experience the backrooms in the most immersive way possible!
